title: CryptoBench: A benchmark of cryptographic API misuse for evaluating LLM code reviewers
description: 54 Python snippets covering nine cryptographic misuse classes (36 vulnerable, 18 matched secure controls), a self-contained harness that queries local Ollama models with a fixed verdict-only prompt, and 1,890 recorded trials across seven open code models (qwen2.5-coder 0.5B to 14B, deepseek-coder 6.7B, codellama 7B). Includes an analysis script that reproduces per-model and per-class detection rates with Wilson 95% confidence intervals. v1.0.1 corrects the documentation: the harness sets no decoding options, so models ran at Ollama default sampling (v1.0.0 README wrongly said temperature 0). Data and results are unchanged.
